audit_items.proof_trace: The function returns current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS without taking max with FULU_FORK_EPOCH when blob_retention_epoch > fulu_fork_epoch. This allows the boundary to fall before Fulu fork when it should be clamped to max(computed_value, FULU_FORK_EPOCH).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnsByRangeRequest with start_slot before FULU_FORK_EPOCH. The validation accepts it because min_epoch_data_availability_boundary incorrectly computes a boundary before Fulu fork. Node attempts to serve pre-Fulu data columns (undefined state).
